metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds John's call, Leadenhall, the loaf, the Shrew, and a thin yard.

yesterday: The flag was up. The play was the Shrew. You came by the fields. Phillips and Pope came by boat.
If anyone asks, there is a man from Norwich lodging here. John has that sentence.
Leadenhall cried butter at fourpence. The loaf is a thumb short of the notch. The page says threepence by the apprentices, fourpence by the constable, fivepence by the sellers.
The aldermen, John says, were already blaming stage-plays for drawing apprentices together. You played anyway. The yard was thin.
The three sheets are still on the board. Tomorrow is church.
